name: Pillar Drop Nav
description: Sticky top navbar whose links drop down like pillars on hover, with neighbouring links following in a wave. Collapses to a plus-icon button and slide-down menu on mobile.
contents: Logo link with blinking eyes face icon
Row of nav links that fill the bar, each with an arrow icon
Mobile plus toggle with slide-down link list
behavior: Bar sticks to the top of the viewport while scrolling
Hovered link drops down and the next two links drop by smaller amounts
Arrow icons fade in and rotate on hover
Below 768px links move into a slide-down panel opened by a rotating plus button
Featured links are hidden below 1280px on desktop
editableByProps: Link labels, URLs, count and which links are featured
Bar, pillar, divider, text and logo accent colors

needsCodeEdit.where: svg with viewBox 0 0 969 955 inside the logo anchor
pdn-blink keyframes in the css constant

needsCodeEdit.change: Change how far neighbouring links drop
needsCodeEdit.where: [&:hover+a]:translate-y-[40%] classes on the desktop link anchor

fixed: Nav is sticky at the top of its scroll container with z-50 and needs content below it to scroll
Logo is a fixed SVG, links open in the same tab
